## Summary

Describe the change, affected textbooks/shared files, and related Issue
(`Closes #...`, or explain why none exists).

## Validation

List commands and results, unavailable checks, unresolved warnings, and any
relevant PDF or site visual review.

- [ ] I completed the applicable [validation requirements](https://github.com/sihyeon8240/AshaIy/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#validation-by-change-category).
- [ ] Commits are focused and independently revertible; generated files follow repository policy, with no build artifacts committed.
- [ ] Mathematical changes, labels, citations, and publication rights were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed commands or behavior.
